name: Human Food Concept
source:
After a day of looking for work, you had a dream in which you met Miel, a strange creature who kidnapped you along with other humans and forced you to participate in an escape room festival… transformed into food?!!

Will you be able to pass the tests, make it out alive, and avoid becoming someone's meal?

[From [url=https://sinnia.itch.io/human-food-concept]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
奔波找了一整天工作后，你在梦中撞见了一个名叫米耶尔的怪异生物——它把你和其他人类一道绑架，强迫你们参加一场密室逃脱庆典……而且还把你们全都变成了食物？！！

你能否顺利通过重重考验、活着逃出生天，避免沦为别人的盘中餐？

[摘自[url=https://sinnia.itch.io/human-food-concept]itch.io[/url]]
